definitions.content:
Chapter 8.1, Manual Sampling of Petroleum and Petroleum Products First Edition, October 1981 (ANSI/ASTM D 4057) This chapter covers the procedures for obtaining representative samples of stocks or shipments of uniform petroleum products, except electrical insulating oils and fluid power hydraulic fluids. Sampling crude petroleum and nonuniform petroleum stocks and shipments are also covered, although the representativeness of results obtained using these sampling methods is in doubt. 21 pages.

Price each, $6.00
